title: 第23章 试探第24章 串通一气
slug: 恶毒师妹失忆后师兄们悔疯了
content_zh:
两人冷战了几天。
其实是阿禾在单方面闹别扭。
她将人留下来也是存了心思的，他们家只剩她一个人了，要是让她嫁出去，她是一万个不愿意。
可要是阿屠哥不肯怎么办？他看着就是要把人娶回家的。
于是阿禾开始蔫了，甚至想着找个机会问问他什么时候离开。
血屠将她的躲避看在眼里，心想真是个小气的女人。
于是在他把一堆猎物带回家里时，两人的关系又和好如初了。
“哇！阿屠哥，这都是你弄来的吗？！好多肉！”
好想吃！！！
血屠被她亮晶晶的视线看得有些不自在，清了清嗓子道：“嗯。”
于是阿禾要赶他走的心思又淡了。
婚事先放一边，填饱肚子最重要！
大黄有肉吃，也不再拆家了，口水一直从嘴巴流下来，看得血屠嫌恶地“啧”了一声。
之后在阿禾的再三请求下，血屠就承担了打猎改善伙食一事。
村里的猎户见他生得高大，力气又大，本想跟他交好。
可他性子冷话又少，周身的戾气即便收敛也让人觉得不安，久而久之也没人上去搭话了。
可一进山林，血屠便变了模样。
他不用弓箭也不用猎刀，只是随手折了一根树枝，便能精准刺中猎物的要害，于是每次都是满载而归。
于是村里的猎户们震惊过后又思考。
天啊，他们现在跪下拜师还来得及吗？

而血屠每次闻到血腥味，身体都会躁动起来，那是刻在魔修骨子里的本能。可当他回去看见阿禾等在门口时，那点嗜血的念头又瞬间消失了。
“阿屠哥，你真厉害！”
阿禾接过他手里的野猪，眼睛都亮了，笑得眉眼弯弯。
好多肉！
滋溜滋溜，今天做什么好呢——
血屠看着她的笑容，周身的冷意竟淡了几分。
当晚阿禾就炖了汤，炒了肉，桌上摆得满满当当，“最大的这块，就留给我们家最大的功臣！”
血屠理直气壮地接受了。
第二块肉是给大黄的，它早就馋得不行了，立刻狼吞虎咽起来。
阿禾最后才给自己夹，一小口一小口地吃，很是珍惜。
她知道这是血屠对自己的好意。
阿爹惹她娘生气时，也只会默默地劈柴，等她第二天早上起来发现后，就不会再生气了。
是不是，其实自己也是有机会的呢？
……
然而平静的日子总是短暂的。
冬天临近时，血屠正在给阿禾劈柴，不然下了雪就很难再上山寻柴了。
当然，这次也不是他亲自动的手。
就在阿禾准备给大黄的窝做得暖些时，村口突然传来一阵嘈杂声。
听到动静，大黄猛地支棱起耳朵，冲到门口好奇地四处张望起来。
阿禾也不做窝了，回头跟血屠说了一声：“我去看看，你要一起吗？”

后者只是懒懒地抬了抬眼皮。
阿禾懂了，拍了拍大黄的头：“走，他不去我们去。”
路上李大娘看到她，顺口解释了一句：“好像是有仙人来了。”
content_en:
The two had a cold war for several days.
In fact, it was Ah He who was causing trouble unilaterally.
She had kept her in mind. She was the only one left in their family. If she was asked to get married, she would be totally unwilling.
But what if Brother Atu refuses? He looks like he wants to marry someone back home.
Then Ah He began to languish, and even thought of finding an opportunity to ask him when he would leave.
Xue Tu saw her avoidance in his eyes and thought to himself that she was really a stingy woman.
So when he brought a bunch of prey home, the relationship between the two was reconciled again.
"Wow! Brother Atu, did you get all this?! So much meat!"
I really want to eat it! ! !
Xue Tu felt a little uncomfortable under her shining gaze, so he cleared his throat and said, "Yes."
Then Ah He's intention of driving him away faded away.
Put it aside before the wedding, filling your stomach is the most important thing!
Rhubarb had meat to eat, so he stopped tearing down the house. Drool kept flowing from his mouth, which made Xue Tu let out a "tsk" in disgust.
Afterwards, at Ah He's repeated request, Xue Tu took on the task of hunting and improving food.
The hunters in the village saw that he was tall and strong, so they wanted to make friends with him.
But he had a temper and said few sarcastic words, and even if the hostility around him subsided, it still made people feel uneasy. As time went by, no one came up to talk to him.
But as soon as he entered the forest, Xue Tu's appearance changed.
He doesn't use a bow or a hunting knife. He just breaks off a branch and stabs the vital part of his prey accurately, so he returns with a full load every time.
So the hunters in the village thought again after being shocked.
Oh my god, is it too late for them to kneel down and worship?
Every time Xue Tu smells the smell of blood, his body will become restless. This is an instinct engraved in the bones of the demon cultivator. But when he went back and saw Ah He waiting at the door, the bloodthirsty thoughts disappeared instantly.
"Brother Atu, you are so awesome!"
Ah He took the wild boar in his hand, his eyes lit up and his eyebrows curled up in a smile.
So much meat!
Ziliu Ziliu, what should you do today——
Xue Tu looked at her smile, and the coldness around him actually faded a bit.
That night, Ah He stewed soup and fried meat. The table was filled with dishes. “The biggest piece will be reserved for the biggest hero in our family!”
Xuetu accepted it confidently.
The second piece of meat was for Rhubarb. He was already very greedy and started gobbling it up immediately.
Ah He finally picked it up for himself and ate it in small bites, cherishing it very much.
She knew this was Xuetu's kindness towards her.
When her father made her mother angry, he would just chop wood silently. When she woke up the next morning and found out, she would not be angry again.
Is it true that you actually have a chance?
…
However, peaceful days are always short-lived.
As winter approaches, Xuetu is chopping firewood for Ahe. Otherwise, it would be difficult to go up the mountain to find firewood if it snows.
Of course, he didn't do it himself this time.
Just when Ah He was about to make Dahuang's nest warmer, there was a sudden noise at the entrance of the village.
Hearing the noise, Dahuang suddenly raised his ears and rushed to the door to look around curiously.
Ah He stopped making a nest and turned around to say to Xue Tu: "I'm going to take a look. Do you want to come with me?"
The latter just lazily raised his eyelids.
Ah He understood and patted Da Huang on the head: "Let's go. If he doesn't go, we will go."
Aunt Li saw her on the way and explained smoothly: "It seems that an immortal is coming."
